title: PACT-WAM: Predicting Actions and Visual Foresight with Compact Temporal Encoding for Robot Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2602.15882v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Robot manipulation uses temporal context to select actions and visual foresight to assess their consequences, yet dense representations of past and future observations incur substantial processing costs. We introduce PACT-WAM, a world-action model that jointly generates a 16-step action trajectory and its temporally corresponding visual forecast through conditional flow sampling. Hierarchical history encoding assigns coarse spatial representations to earlier observations and finer representations to recent ones, retaining 16 observations with 256 tokens per view, 75% fewer than dense encoding of the same frames. A shared flow module jointly updates continuous action and visual states through two modality-specific heads under transition-wise causal attention, and a TiTok-VAE decoder reconstructs multi-view future images from the visual latents. translated_title: PACT-WAM：基于紧凑时间编码的机器人操作动作预测与视觉预见
translated_abstract: 机器人操作利用时间上下文来选择动作，并利用视觉预见来评估动作后果，然而对过去和未来观测的密集表示会产生巨大的处理开销。我们提出了PACT-WAM，这是一种世界-动作模型，通过条件流采样联合生成16步动作轨迹及其时间对应的视觉预测。层次化历史编码为较早的观测分配粗略的空间表示，为较近的观测分配更精细的表示，在保留16个观测的同时每个视角仅使用256个token，比相同帧的密集编码减少了75%。一个共享的流模块在转换级因果注意力机制下，通过两个模态特定的输出头联合更新连续的动作状态和视觉状态，并由TiTok-VAE解码器从视觉潜变量中重建多视角未来图像。解码后的预测还支持提案审查，这是一个视觉-语言模型组件
tldr: PACT-WAM提出了一种世界-动作模型，通过层次化时间编码（相比密集编码减少75%的token）和共享流模块，联合生成机器人操作的多步动作轨迹与对应的多视角视觉预测，实现高效的动作选择与后果评估。
en_tdlr: PACT-WAM is a world-action model that jointly generates 16-step action trajectories and temporally aligned multi-view visual forecasts through compact hierarchical temporal encoding (75% fewer tokens than dense encoding) and a shared flow module, enabling efficient action selection and consequence assessment for robot manipulation.
